decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The use hereby permitted shall be begun before 5 years from the date of this permission and shall be carried on only by Mrs. S Uawithya. When the premises cease to be occupied by Mrs. S. Uawithya the use hereby permitted shall cease and all equipment brought onto the premises in connection with the use shall be removed.
Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: Monday-Saturday 07.00 - 18.00

Condition : 3 - Before the installation of any cooking equipment for use in association with this use a scheme for any necessary ventilation of that equipment shall be submitted to and agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority. The agreed scheme shall be implemented before any such cooking equipment is brought into use.
Condition : 4 - No deep fat frying shall take place on the premises at any time.
description: Change of use to cafe (A3) with personal permission.
